overview_description.description: PropelAuth provides a full-service auth solution for B2B companies, helping them to better onboard and manage their users without sacrificing developer resources and time. Designed to eliminate B2B-specific pain points, PropelAuth includes essential B2B features, like organization management, test environments, and hierarchical roles—all available via self service UIs.

about_short_description.short_description: PropelAuth provides a full-service auth solution for B2B companies, helping them to better onboard and manage their users.

product.name: PropelAuth Authentication Platform
product.description: A cloud-based authentication solution designed specifically for B2B companies to manage user onboarding, organization management, and secure access.

product.name: Organization Management
product.description: A feature set enabling B2B customers to manage organizations, roles, permissions, and access controls within their user base.

product.name: Enterprise SSO and Security Features
product.description: Supports enterprise single sign-on (SSO) with unlimited SAML connections, multi-factor authentication enforcement, audit logs, and advanced security controls.

product.name: User Impersonation
product.description: Allows authorized team members to log in as users to provide support, perform demos, and debug issues with controlled access and session limits.

product.name: On-Premises Authentication Solution
product.description: An authentication solution designed for on-premises or private cloud deployments, providing enterprise-grade security and integration with customer identity providers.
